what.a: Raqeem is an interactive learning platform that helps elementary students review their lessons through curriculum-based questions and activities, with a points-and-rewards system tied to the child's career headquarters.

who.a: Raqeem is designed for elementary students and their parents: the child reviews lessons while the parent follows progress from their account.

curriculum.q: Are the questions linked to the school curriculum?
curriculum.a: Yes. Raqeem content is built from the lessons in the target curriculum for each grade and subject.

points.q: How does the child earn points?
points.a: The child earns points for correct answers on questions and activities, then uses them to get tools and furnishings for their career headquarters.

hq.a: It is a personal space linked to the career the child chooses. They can develop and furnish it using points earned from reviewing lessons.

ai.q: How does Raqeem use artificial intelligence?
ai.a: Raqeem is building AI to analyze student performance and provide reports and recommendations for parents, and to rephrase questions the child missed inside review stations while keeping curriculum concepts and terminology. These features are in development for the first release of the platform.

aiReplace.q: Does AI replace the teacher or the parent?
aiReplace.a: No. AI on Raqeem is an assistive tool to improve review and clarify the child's performance — not a replacement for teachers or parental follow-up.

childAccount.q: Does the child need a separate account?
childAccount.a: No. The parent creates their account, adds a profile for each child, and manages all children from one account.

free.a: Yes. You can start using Raqeem for free during the current phase.

availability.q: Which grades and subjects are available now?
availability.a: Raqeem supports elementary grades 1 through 6, and all seven subjects are available now: Arabic, English, French, Mathematics, Religious education, Social studies, and Science.

finalCta.title: Start a more enjoyable review journey with your child
finalCta.body: Create your account, add your child's profile, and let them discover how lessons turn into progress they can see and build.

footer.blurb: A daily review platform for elementary students, guided by parents, with rewards that build a child's dream.
